design: Jaipur Rugs looms in Rajasthan: (i) rug-level data 2017-2021 relating the continuous average days between supervisor visits to weaving rate; (ii) a field implementation in one branch where looms of selected treatment supervisors all started optimized routes on April 16, 2023, with the other supervisors' looms as controls (visit-level data March 1-September 30, 2023).
reason: Tables 1-2 regress log weaving rate on a continuous visit-frequency measure with loom, harvest-season, and year fixed effects plus rug controls, and an IV version using supervisor-to-loom distance; this is continuous treatment and IV, not DiD. Table 4 is a DiD with loom and month fixed effects, but every treated loom adopts on the same date (April 16, 2023), so the design is a single-date treated/control comparison, and it also includes time-varying controls (product width, knot density of the rug on the loom).
appendix_only_specs: Online Appendix O.7 reports parallel-trend checks, a balanced pre/post panel, and temporal variation of the field-implementation effect; all use the single April 16, 2023 start date.
notes: Table 4 Treat coefficient 0.167 (SE 0.047), 5,913 visit-level observations. Treatment supervisors were selected (not randomized) with lower baseline weaving rates.
data_statement: States 'All supplemental materials, including the code, data, and files required to reproduce the results, are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/opre.2024.1009', while the text describes the rug and visit data as proprietary data sets from the collaborator Jaipur Rugs.
